header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) Endure Hardships and difficulties when Giving Da'wah towards Allaah

blocks.text: Abdillaah. However, if you like, I shall go with you to see your son." Ummul Khayr agreed and Ummu Jameel accompanied her until they came to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) who was lying down (unable to even sit) and extremely ill. Coming closer, Ummu Jameel cried, "By Allaah! Those who did this to you must be people of kufr and sin! I hope that Allaah takes revenge from them on your behalf."

Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) then asked, "How is Rasulullaah ﷺ?" Ummu Jameel said, "Your mother is listening." He said, "You have nothing to fear from her." She then replied, "Rasulullaah ﷺ is safe and sound." "Where is he?" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) asked further. Ummu Jameel said, "He is in the house of Arqam." Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) vowed, "I swear by Allaah that I shall neither eat or drink until I go to Rasulullaah ﷺ." The two ladies then waited for a time (late at night) when the movement of people had calmed down and people were resting. Giving him support, they then took him to Rasulullaah ﷺ. (When he saw Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)) Rasulullaah ﷺ hugged him and kissed him. The other Muslims also hugged him and (seeing his battered condition) Rasulullaah ﷺ took great pity on him.

Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said, "May my parents be sacrificed for you, O Rasulullaah ﷺ! There is nothing wrong with me except for what that wretch did to my face. This is my mother who has been exceptionally good to me. You are a most blessed person so invite her towards Allaah and pray for her. Perhaps Allaah shall use you to save her from the Fire of Jahannam." Rasulullaah ﷺ then made du'aa for her and invited her to believe in Allaah. She then accepted Islaam.

For a month, the Muslims who numbered thirty-nine individuals stayed with Rasulullaah ﷺ in that house. Hadhrat Hamza bin Abdil Muttalib (RA) (the uncle of Rasulullaah ﷺ) accepted Islaam on the day that Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) was beaten up.
Rasulullaah ﷺ Prays for Hadhrat Umar (RA) and he Accepts Islaam

Rasulullaah ﷺ made du'aa for (Allaah to guide) Hadhrat Umar (RA) or Abu Jahal bin Hishaam. The du'aa was made on a Wednesday and Hadhrat Umar (RA) accepted Islaam on Thursday. (When Hadhrat Umar (RA) accepted Islaam) The Muslims shouted "Allaahu Akbar" so loudly that their shout was heard in the upper parts of Makkah. The father of Hadhrat Arqam (RA) who was a blind man and a Kaafir came out of his house saying, "O Allaah! Forgive my child Arqam for he has rejected our religion."

(When he accepted Islaam) Hadhrat Umar (RA) said to Rasulullaah ﷺ, "Why should we keep our religion secret when we are on the truth while the false religion of the Kuffaar is made public?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "We are too few and you have just seen the beating we received." Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "I swear by the Being that has sent you with the truth that I shall make my Imaan
